{
  "name": "ant-farm",
  "version": "0.3.5",
  "description": "Mission control for your subagents: what each one is doing, its activity and its cost, live.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/ant-farm",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/ant-farm#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "subagents",
    "cost",
    "tokens",
    "budget",
    "pane",
    "visibility"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "budgetUsd": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Session budget (USD)",
      "description": "Off (0) unless you set one. When the session's estimated spend (Claude Code's own estimate, else the price-table estimate) reaches this, ant-farm shows a toast and turns its budget mark amber; past twice it, red. It only warns: it never stops Claude.",
      "default": 0
    }
  }
}
